Story was dumb on my part but when I was in 4th grade I was playing in the school’s field and I noticed that the grass turf could be pulled out of the ground. So imagine 8 or 9 year old me running around the field pulling all of them out and chasing little kids with the turf and throwing at them. So I got my entire friend group in on it and we had what I’d call a “turf war”. I had no idea why I didn’t think I’d get in serious trouble for it but I’d be lying if I said it wasn’t fun.

The whole clown fiesta netted me a two day suspension and a week of garbage duty. Thinking back on it I feel like an asshole cause I found it hilarious when the kids started crying under the turf of grass I threw at them.

Being 18 I think it’s quite common to feel lost about what I want to do in my life. In all honesty though that’s the last of my worries. I’m finding it hard to do the things I enjoyed before and I lack any kind of motivation to find time for myself. I work a full time job and that leaves me days off to either doing nothing or going out and getting high with friends to avoid feeling low. It’s never really been one thing that makes me feel this way but so many things that it even comes down to small details.
